text:
sam (eng-platform): heads up — noticed a handful of small invoice adjustments this morning, all tied to tail events from AP-south. dashboard shows +0.1–0.6% token deltas after cutoff. link: https://console/redwood/invoices/summary?id=acct_42 :eyes:

olivia (billing-eng): ugh. are these duplicates or genuinely late events?

sam (eng-platform): looks like late-arrival events (ingest timestamp > invoice_cutoff). many have request_id but no stable sequence_id. appears retried at edge then delivered to event bus after cutoff window.

kevin (eng-ml): do we have a dedupe key in the pipeline for request_id + tenant? if retries don't include same request_id we can't dedupe.

sam (eng-platform): current dedupe uses event_id from router, but router generates new event_id on retry sometimes. so it's not reliable.

maria (console-ui): users are seeing sudden small charges and one-off negative adjustments the next day. UX is confusing. can we add an invoice note or pending-adjustment flag? :thinking_face:

olivia (billing-eng): short term we can surface "pending adjustments" in invoice UI, yes. long term we need better SOT for token counts.

dustin (eng-infra): quick mitigation: hold a 5-minute watermark delay at the aggregator before closing window for invoice generation. that would catch most late arrivals without major delay. config snippet:

```
aggregator.window_size = 1h
aggregator.finalize_grace = 300s  # 5m watermark
```

sam (eng-platform): that helps, but won't cover cross-region routing delays >5m. also increases invoice latency which product might not like.

adele (product): product preference is predictable invoice cutover at midnight. small delays are okay, but customers hate charge noise. can we avoid retroactive line items?

kevin (eng-ml): alternative: make routing include a stable id that survives retries. add header X-redwood-request-uid assigned at client edge and propagated. then dedupe on (tenant, request_uid).

sam (eng-platform): agreed. but requires edge change + backfilled dedupe logic in ingestion. rollout plan?

dustin (eng-infra): we can deploy an ingress middleware update quickly to set request_uid when missing. then ingestion layer will keep a 72-hour cache for dedupe lookups. memory cost is manageable with TTL.

olivia (billing-eng): if we do that, we should also flag any events that were accepted before dedupe rollout as "maybe-duplicate" and run a reconciliation job to adjust invoices instead of immediate crediting. Need audit trail.

maria (console-ui): UI idea — show "invoice adjustments pending reconciliation" banner and add a small link "what changed" that expands to a machine-readable list of affected request_ids. keeps support load down.

sam (eng-platform): proposed immediate steps:
- ingress middleware: set X-redwood-request-uid when missing (can be 1h rollout)
- ingestion: add dedupe on (tenant, request_uid) + 72h TTL cache
- aggregator: temporary 5m finalize_grace to reduce majority of noise
- billing: add "pending_adjustment" flag to invoice events and show in UI
- recon job: scan last 7 days for duplicates and emit audit log/event for manual review

olivia (billing-eng): +1. also add a metric: invoices_with_adjustments_ratio and an alert at 0.5% over 24h.

kevin (eng-ml): one more thought — do we want to canonicalize event timestamps to router-received-time vs client-time? router_recd_time is safer for cutoff logic.

sam (eng-platform): yes, switch finalize cutoff to use router_recd_time for windowing. that avoids client clock skew exploits. note: will need to surface this change in docs.

adele (product): timeline request: can we have ingress + ingestion changes staged in 3 business days, aggregator grace next deployment, and UI flags within 1 week?

dustin (eng-infra): ingress middleware patch can go tomorrow to canary, full roll in 48h. ingestion dedupe change needs schema bump but small. aggregator change is a config flip. UI work I'd estimate 4 business days.

sam (eng-platform): I'll draft the rollout steps in a PR and include the reconciliation job SQL. sample dedupe query for recon job: 

```
SELECT tenant_id, request_uid, count(*) as cnt
FROM billing_events
WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id, request_uid
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

olivia (billing-eng): perfect. please tag me on the PR. also ping legal if any adjustments cross accounting periods.

maria (console-ui): I'll mock the banner and the "pending adjustments" modal and post screenshots in #design later today.

recon-bot: automated note — a previous recon job (2026-03-18) flagged 42 potential late-event duplicates for ap-south. ticket: BW-1742.

sam (eng-platform): thanks. final note: let's avoid blanket credits. prefer reconciliation + audit trail + UI transparency. smaller changes first. :thumbsup:

olivia (billing-eng): agreed. i'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for the status page in case support gets pings.

adele (product): thanks team — meeting to sync tomorrow 9:30 to finalize timeline.
